## renv — package version locking
To lock exact package versions for reproducibility, run once from the R console
after all packages are installed and working:
```r
# renv::init()     # first time: initialise and snapshot
# renv::snapshot() # after adding/updating packages
# renv::restore()  # collaborators run this to install exact same versions
```
Do NOT run renv::init() mid-analysis — do it when the project is stable and
ready for GitHub. The renv.lock file should be committed to the repository.

## functions
```{r functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# function to remove rows with n number of NA's
delete.na <- function(DF, n=0) {
  DF[rowSums(is.na(DF)) <= n,]
}
```

## define universal variables
```{r define_universal}

stud_pat <- "RS_surface"

## All inputs, outputs, and plots live in the '2026 RS eDNA' folder.
## here::here() resolves the absolute path from the .Rproj root, so this
## works both when knitting and when running chunks interactively in RStudio.
dir         <- paste0(here::here("2026 RS eDNA"), "/")
dada2_path  <- paste0(dir, "Dada2_output/")   # DADA2 pipeline output files
export_file <- ""                              # CSV exports → dir
out_file    <- ""                              # summary outputs → dir
summary_file<- ""                              # manuscript tables → dir

# name for the main filtered data CSV saved at the end
export_name <- paste0(stud_pat, "_filtered_data_all.csv")

## set some other universal variables

####  !!!! need to be in alphabetical order - tabs in sam_file should match these names too !!!!! also have "type"" column
primers<-c('18smini',"euka02")  # 18S_V9 and 18S_V7 only; CO1 and 12S excluded
n_primers<-length(primers)
## must be in alphabetical order
minboots<-c("insect",50,70,90)  # for getting all data minboots and insect data
min_insect_score<-0.80# set minimum score for insect taxa score
###################           filtering parameters
## filter based on occurance in samples
min_samples_include<-2  # used duing filtering SV's in < this number will be removed

## filter based on proportion in samples
sam_sum_prop_cut<-0.0001 ## remove SV's with less than this propotion of reads per miseq
      # examples 10 million reads if 0.0001 then remove SV with lesst than 100 reads (remove ~25-50% SV) .......OK  USED
      # examples 10 million reads if 0.001 then remove SV with lesst than 1000 reads (remove ~60-80% SV) .......conservative
     # logic - if very low percent in sample samples, then likely errors.

## decontam: numeric proxy for below-detection-limit DNA concentration
## Samples recorded as "<0.50 ng/mL" in the Excel are read as NA by openxlsx.
## decontam requires all concentration values to be positive numbers (> 0),
## so below-detection samples are assigned this proxy value instead of NA.
## It means "DNA present but unquantifiable" — adjust if your detection limit differs.
decontam_conc_low <- 0.01  # ng/µl proxy for samples with conc recorded as "<0.50 ng/mL"

## contamination removal: minimum number of blank samples an SV must appear in
## (reads > 0) to be removed as a contaminant.  Used in decontam_check together
## with decontam (combined method) — SVs are removed if flagged by EITHER rule.
blank_n_remove <- 3

## set minumum number for rarefaction -- some samples usually have very few reads, partucularly for cores
#    !!!!!!! estimate run script and look at rare_mins,..... then choose!!!  !!!!!!!! -- 1000 to 5000 ?????????
min_num_rarefaction<-5000

#  stil run but NO longer used - now based on occurance within each miseq run - at later time.

#####################
##   for summary tables
###  change from old to new names
primers_summary_old<-c("euka02",'18smini')
primer_names<-data.frame( "Primer1"=c("18S_V7","18S_V9"), "primer_pair"= primers_summary_old, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
primers_summary<-c("18S_V7","18S_V9")
minboots_summary<-c("70")  # character to match taxa_assign column after separate()


############
################### set file path and name of sample data
## each primer should have own sheet with name matching primers
## primer sheets first then location sheet (1 row per each sample location), then other sheets with relevent data
sam_file_path <- paste0(dir, "RS_surface_sample_data_all.xlsx")

## number of columns in the primers specific sheets, should be the same for all primer pairs, 
num_sample_cols<-10  ####
##

```


## import data
Sample data excel sheet should include sheet for each primer pair - samples id column then other info
then a sheet with locations, then a sheet with other sample relevant data
It then imports data from DADA2 pipeline
```{r import}
# sample data -- will need Quality control !!! make sure sample_se make sense
sheets <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(sam_file_path)
sam_dat <- lapply(sheets,openxlsx::read.xlsx,xlsxFile=sam_file_path)  # mes1<-sam_dat[[2]]   names(mes1)  names(sam_dat)
names(sam_dat) <- sheets   # add name to each list

##    move to next .Rmd - nothing to do here
# locations<-sam_dat[[n_primers+1]]  # isolate locations  ! double check depending
sample_dat<-sam_dat$sample_data # isolate other data
##

sam_dat <-sam_dat[1:n_primers]   # keep only primer sample data
sam_dat <- lapply(sam_dat, function(df) mutate_at(df, .vars="sample_ID", as.character))  # make sure sample_ID is character
sample_sam<-bind_rows(sam_dat, .id = 'id')  # names(sample_sam)   ## bind al primer pair data into single datagrame

#  import taxonomy assigned to sequences  
# summary, seqtab and taxass    list.files()    unique(sam$type)
## list.files with explicit path — avoids setwd() side-effects in Rmd
## full.names=TRUE returns the complete path so read functions work regardless of WD
f_tax <- list.files(path = dada2_path, pattern = paste0(stud_pat, ".*taxass.*\\.csv"), full.names = TRUE)
f_sum <- list.files(path = dada2_path, pattern = paste0(stud_pat, ".*summary\\.csv"),  full.names = TRUE)
f_rds <- list.files(path = dada2_path, pattern = paste0(stud_pat, ".*seqtab\\.rds"),   full.names = TRUE)
##   import all data into lists            names(sum)  names(tax_list)
###  may need to add  "sample1" to last column ????
tax_list<-setNames(lapply(f_tax, read.csv), tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f_tax)))  # mes1<-tax_list[[2]]  names(mes1)


## make sure tax_list names match primer names and sample_sam
intersect(primers, names(sam_dat))
# intersect(primers, names(tax_list))

# get index for insect taxonomy assigned and add taxonomy comparable to assigntaxonomy from DADA2
tax_list_insect_num<-grep("insect", names(tax_list))
# fix taxonomy of insect    match insect name to dada2 nameing
for (i in tax_list_insect_num){
     tax_list[[i]]<-tax_list[[i]] %>% 
       # mes1<-tax_list[[9]]   %>% 
       dplyr::rename(Superkingdom=superkingdom, Kingdom=kingdom,Phylum=phylum, Class=class, Order=order, Family=family, Genus=genus, Species=species ) %>% 
       mutate(X = taxID) %>%  ## add to match seq from tax assign
        select(-representative,-taxID,-taxon,-rank) %>%
       mutate_if(is.factor, as.character) %>% 
       mutate_at(vars(Superkingdom:Species), list(~na_if(., ""))) %>% # convert blank to NA
       mutate_at(vars(Superkingdom:Species), list(~ifelse(!is.na(score) &  score < min_insect_score, NA, .))) %>%  ## min score turn taxa blank   -  min_insect_score !is.na(score) &
       select(-score, -contains("sample1")) ## 3 remove score
     }
 ## mes1<-tax_list[[9]]       names(mes1)
       



# get summary of reads from filter steps of DADA2

summar<-setNames(lapply(f_sum, read.csv), tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f_sum)))  # names(summar) mes1<-summar[[1]] 
## get seqtab tables from dada2  -- sample_id are row names and colnames are SV sequence
sv_list<-setNames(lapply(f_rds, readRDS), tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f_rds))) # mes1<-sv_list[[2]]  row.names(mes1)
```

## tidy data

```{r tidy}
#######################################
# tidy     ! DADA2  summary tables !    table from dada2 pipe

## make column name lower for sample information
sample_dat<-sample_dat %>% 
    rename_all(tolower)


#######   tidy summary data     #################
## add column for primer and sampple_id  mes<-summar[[1]]  mes<-mes$sample_id
for (i in seq_along(summar)){
  summar[[i]]["sample_num"] <- rownames(summar[[i]]) }  #  
## most are numbers so need to convert to sample_id from sample sheets, switching between sample_num and sample_id need to be chekced

# bind into dataframe
sum2<-bind_rows(summar, .id = 'names(sum)')
names(sum2)[1]<-"study_primer"
## get name of primer and clean up - NEED TO CHECK each time !!!!
sum2 <-sum2 %>% 
  rename_all(tolower) %>% 
  mutate(primer=study_primer) %>%
  mutate(primer=gsub("^.*?_","",primer)) %>%  # remove everything before first "_"
  mutate(primer=gsub("_[^_]+$","",primer)) %>%   # remove after last "_"
   mutate(primer=gsub("^.*?_","",primer)) %>% 
  mutate(primer=gsub("_","",primer)) %>%   # remove any "_"
  mutate(study_primer=gsub("_[^_]+$","",study_primer))


##############################################################################
#########    tidy miseq specific data    then   combine with summary   ######### 
#   names(sam)  unique(sam$primer)  unique(sum2$primer)

# add total number of sequences per sample to each primer sheet
sample_sam<-sample_sam[,c(1:num_sample_cols)]# keep only common columns  names(sample_sam) 
sam2<-sample_sam %>%
  rename_all(tolower) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(primer=id) %>% 
  mutate(sample_num=as.character(sample_num)) %>% 
  left_join(sum2[,7:9]) %>% # keep only nonchim,id,primer
  dplyr::rename(reads_per_sample_dada=nonchim)   ### reads after DADA2 filters

###### set up sample data-sam2 to merge with tax data
# set sample list for each primer  use sam2 by primer
sam_list<-split(sam2,f=sam2$primer) # names(sam_list)   # split data from each primer into list

#  get index to call column names of sample types   x<-sam_list[[1]]
##      !!!!!!!!!    need to sort samples in alpabetical order    !!!!! see lines below
## for most miseqs we just use sample_num, during pipe this is ordered as character, so need to be aware
##  need for next step of indexing columns to sepcify sample type
sam_list<- lapply(sam_list, function(x) { 
  row_number_original<-c(1:length(as.numeric(row.names(x)))) 
  x$sample_num<-as.character(x$sample_num)
  x<-arrange(x,sample_num)
  row.names(x)<-NULL
  row_number<-c(1:length(as.numeric(row.names(x)))) # make index for choose columns of SVs - SV from DADA2 arranges columns by !!!alphabet !!!!! - need to arrage accordingly
  x<-cbind(x,row_number,row_number_original)    })
# replicate to match list with primers and nboots.
 sam_list<-rep(sam_list, each=length(minboots))
 #####
 
## make lists for each sample type, needed for filtering  x<-sample_index_list[[6]]  unique(sam2$type) x<-sam_list[[3]]
sample_index_list<- lapply(sam_list, function(x) { 
  x<-x$row_number[x$type=="sample"]     })
#
blank_index_list<- lapply(sam_list, function(x) { 
  x<-x$row_number[x$type=="extraction blank" | x$type=="pcr blank"]     })  # x<-blank_index_list[[3]] 
#
positive_index_list<- lapply(sam_list, function(x) { 
  x<-x$row_number[x$type=="positive control" | x$type=="mock"]     })
#
all_index_list<- lapply(sam_list, function(x) { 
  x<-x$row_number    })

### make SV list into LIST of dataframes ######################################
dat<-purrr::map(sv_list, data.frame)
# make rownames a column, rownames were sample identification, which we use sample number  -  mes<-dat[[1]]  mes$sample_num
dat<-purrr::map(dat, function(x) rownames_to_column(x, var="sample_num"))  #  mes<- rownames(dat[[3]]) names(dat) all_index_list[[3]]
```


## get cluster seqs (cluster)
  updated Sept 2024 from arctic surface - seqateurs::cluster_otus no longer worked
```{r cluster}

 cluster_dat <- dat# make list
#. i<-1
for (i in seq_along(dat)){

 cluster_sub<- cluster_dat[[i]]   # remove sample number
 cluster_sub<-cluster_sub[,-1]

asv_sequences <- colnames(cluster_sub)
seqs <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(asv_sequences)

otus <- DECIPHER::Clusterize(
    seqs,
    cutoff = 0.03,  # use `cutoff = 0.03` for a 97% OTU
    method = "overlap",
    includeTerminalGaps = FALSE,
    penalizeGapLetterMatches = NA,
    minCoverage = 0.5,
    maxAlignments = 100,
    invertCenters = FALSE,
    processors = 4) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(sequence = asv_sequences)  %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster_size = n_distinct(sequence)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

cluster_dat[[i]]<-otus

}
```

## begin filtering

```{r filter}
####    begin filter SV based on # samples and blanks
####################################################################################
      #  mes1<-dat3[[11]]  names(mes1)  mes2<-dat3[[2]]   # names(dat4)  mes0<-tax_list[[2]]  names(tax_list)

after_n_occurance_per_sample <- vector("list", length(names(dat4)))# make dummy list

after_n_occurance_per_sample1 <- vector("list", length(names(dat4)))# make dummy list mes<-after_n_occurance_per_sample[[1]]

        after_n_occurance_per_sample1[[i]]<-apply(mes2[,all_index_list[[i]]], 2, sum) # all_index_list was changed apr23,2020
             dat4[[i]]<-mes2
      }     #  mes2<-dat4[[16]]  mes1<-dat4[[16]]  names(mes2)  names(mes1)

#### remove SVs with very low proportional reads in samples (likely sequencing errors)
#### contamination removal (blank-based + decontam) is applied in the decontam_check chunk

dat_filt <- dat4   # copy for downstream filtering   names(dat4)  names(dat2[[1]])

# summary lists for sam_sum_prop filter step (populated below)
after_min_sample_filt        <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_min_sample_filt) <- primers_minboot
after_min_sample_filt1       <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_min_sample_filt1) <- primers_minboot
after_min_sample_filt_SVsam  <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_min_sample_filt_SVsam) <- primers_minboot

# summary lists for contamination filter step (populated in decontam_check)
after_blank_filt        <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_blank_filt) <- primers_minboot
after_blank_filt1       <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_blank_filt1) <- primers_minboot
after_blank_filt_SVsam  <- vector("list", length(primers_minboot))
names(after_blank_filt_SVsam) <- primers_minboot

for (i in seq_along(dat_filt)) {    #  i<-1
  mes1 <- dat_filt[[i]]

  sv_sum <- apply(mes1[, sample_index_list[[i]]], 1, sum)
  mes1$sam_sum_prop <- sv_sum / sum(sv_sum)

  # remove SVs with < sam_sum_prop_cut proportion of total reads — likely errors
  mes2 <- mes1[mes1$sam_sum_prop > sam_sum_prop_cut, ]
  mes2 <- dplyr::select(mes2, -sam_sum_prop)

  dat_filt[[i]] <- mes2

  # summary stats for this step
  after_min_sample_filt[[i]]       <- length(row.names(mes2))
  after_min_sample_filt1[[i]]      <- apply(mes2[, all_index_list[[i]]], 2, sum)
  after_min_sample_filt_SVsam[[i]] <- apply(mes2[, all_index_list[[i]]], 2, function(x) sum(x > 0))
}
     
 # convert all factors to characters
 #  and
 # remove taxonomy that are not assigned to any taxonomy  !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
  after_taxa_clean <- vector("list", length(names(dat_filt)))# for calc of lost SVs
  names(after_taxa_clean) <- primers_minboot
   after_taxa_clean1 <- vector("list", length(names(dat_filt)))# for calc of lost reads
   names(after_taxa_clean1) <- primers_minboot
   after_taxa_clean1_SVsam <- vector("list", length(names(dat_filt)))# for calc of lost reads
   names(after_taxa_clean1_SVsam) <- primers_minboot
 #  mes1<-dat_filt[[10]]

    for (i in seq_along(dat_filt)){

      tidyr::unite(lineage, Superkingdom:Species,sep=";",remove=F) %>%

        # get data for summary
```

## decontam contamination removal (combined method) + blank-count filter
Removes SVs flagged by decontam OR present in ≥ `blank_n_remove` blanks.
Updates `dat_filt` in place — run before `sum_by_taxa`.
Install decontam if needed: BiocManager::install("decontam")

```{r decontam_check}
library(decontam)

## Contamination removal: decontam combined method (frequency + prevalence) OR
## present in ≥ blank_n_remove blanks.  Runs at summary minboot (minboots_summary).
## Updates dat_filt in place; run before sum_by_taxa.
##
## Concentration source: extr_dna_conc. from sample_data tab (extracted DNA, pre-PCR).
##   - Frequency test uses TRUE SAMPLES ONLY — blanks ignored (B. Callahan, decontam #88).
##   - Prevalence test uses the neg vector independently of concentration.

tax_cols    <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
decontam_idx <- which(grepl(paste0(";", minboots_summary, "$"), primers_minboot))

# sample_id → extracted DNA concentration (lowercased in tidy chunk)
conc_lookup <- sample_dat %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, extr_dna_conc.) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

## ── 1. run decontam ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
decontam_res <- purrr::map(decontam_idx, function(i) {
  primer_id <- primers_minboot[i]
  meta      <- sam_list[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::left_join(conc_lookup, by = "sample_id")

  # samples × SVs matrix (rows = samples)
  sv_mat <- t(as.matrix(dat_filt[[i]][, all_index_list[[i]]]))

  neg  <- meta$type %in% c("extraction blank", "pcr blank")
  # suppressWarnings: "<0.50 ng/mL" strings → NA by design
  conc <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$extr_dna_conc.))
  conc[is.na(conc) & !neg] <- decontam_conc_low   # below-detection samples
  conc[is.na(conc) &  neg] <- decontam_conc_low   # blanks (not in sample_dat)

  contam_df <- isContaminant(sv_mat, conc = conc, neg = neg,
                             method = "combined", threshold = 0.1)
  contam_df$primer_taxassign_id <- primer_id
  contam_df
})
names(decontam_res) <- primers_minboot[decontam_idx]

## ── 2. prepare plot data (built pre-filter so all SVs are visible) ────────────

## p1_data: decontam scores stacked across primers for facet histogram
p1_data <- purrr::imap_dfr(decontam_res, function(df, nm) {
  dplyr::mutate(df, primer = nm)
})

## decontam_plot_data: inputs for decontam::plot_frequency (one entry per primer)
decontam_plot_data <- lapply(seq_along(decontam_idx), function(j) {
  idx  <- decontam_idx[j]
  nm   <- names(decontam_res)[j]
  meta <- sam_list[[idx]] %>%
    dplyr::left_join(conc_lookup, by = "sample_id")
  neg  <- meta$type %in% c("extraction blank", "pcr blank")
  conc <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$extr_dna_conc.))
  conc[is.na(conc)] <- decontam_conc_low
  sv_mat <- t(as.matrix(dat_filt[[idx]][, all_index_list[[idx]]]))
  # plot_frequency requires character column names — assign row names explicitly
  # (default integer row names can be lost through matrix coercion)
  colnames(sv_mat) <- as.character(rownames(dat_filt[[idx]]))
  flagged <- which(decontam_res[[nm]]$contaminant)
  top_svs <- if (length(flagged) > 0)
    head(flagged[order(decontam_res[[nm]]$p[flagged])], 5) else integer(0)
  # short taxonomy label for each top SV: "Genus Species (p=X)"
  taxon_labels <- if (length(top_svs) > 0) {
    paste0(
      dat_filt[[idx]][top_svs, "Genus"], " ",
      dat_filt[[idx]][top_svs, "Species"],
      " (p=", round(decontam_res[[nm]]$p[top_svs], 3), ")"
    )
  } else character(0)
  list(nm = nm, sv_mat = sv_mat, conc = conc, neg = neg,
       top_svs = top_svs, taxon_labels = taxon_labels)
})

## ── 3. diagnostic tables (keep for future reference) ─────────────────────────

## SVs flagged by decontam — full taxonomy + p-value
decontam_flagged <- purrr::imap_dfr(decontam_res, function(df, nm) {
  idx     <- which(primers_minboot == nm)
  flagged <- which(df$contaminant)
  if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
  sv_sum  <- apply(dat_filt[[idx]][flagged, all_index_list[[idx]]], 1, sum)
  dat_filt[[idx]][flagged, tax_cols] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(primer_taxassign_id = nm,
                  sample_reads        = sv_sum,
                  decontam_p          = df$p[flagged]) %>%
    dplyr::select(primer_taxassign_id, all_of(tax_cols), sample_reads, decontam_p)
}) %>% dplyr::arrange(primer_taxassign_id, desc(sample_reads))

## SVs present in ≥ 1 blank — shows how blank count varies across taxa
blank_n_taxa <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(decontam_idx), function(j) {
  idx <- decontam_idx[j]
  nm  <- primers_minboot[idx]
  if (length(blank_index_list[[idx]]) == 0) return(NULL)
  blank_mat <- dat_filt[[idx]][, blank_index_list[[idx]], drop = FALSE]
  n_blanks  <- rowSums(blank_mat > 0)
  sv_sum    <- apply(dat_filt[[idx]][, sample_index_list[[idx]]], 1, sum)
  dat_filt[[idx]] %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(tax_cols)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(primer_taxassign_id = nm,
                  sample_reads        = sv_sum,
                  n_blanks            = n_blanks) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_blanks >= 1)
}) %>%
  tidyr::separate(primer_taxassign_id, into = c("primer_pair", "minboot"),
                  sep = ";", remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(primer_pair, all_of(tax_cols), sample_reads, n_blanks) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(primer_pair, desc(n_blanks), desc(sample_reads))

cat("\ndecontam flagged", nrow(decontam_flagged), "SVs\n")
decontam_flagged

cat("\nSVs appearing in ≥ 1 blank (n_blanks column; blank_n_remove =", blank_n_remove, "):\n")
blank_n_taxa

## ── 4. apply combined filter to dat_filt (all primer × minboot combinations) ─
## decontam is run at summary minboot; flagged SV row names are matched by row
## name across all minboot thresholds for the same primer pair.

# build a named list: primer_pair → SV row names flagged by decontam
decontam_sv_names <- setNames(
  lapply(seq_along(decontam_idx), function(j) {
    idx     <- decontam_idx[j]
    flagged <- which(decontam_res[[j]]$contaminant)
    row.names(dat_filt[[idx]])[flagged]
  }),
  sapply(primers_minboot[decontam_idx], function(x) strsplit(x, ";")[[1]][1])
)

for (i in seq_along(dat_filt)) {
  primer_pair <- strsplit(primers_minboot[i], ";")[[1]][1]

  # decontam-flagged SVs for this primer (from summary minboot run)
  dc_sv <- if (primer_pair %in% names(decontam_sv_names))
    decontam_sv_names[[primer_pair]] else character(0)

  # SVs present in ≥ blank_n_remove blanks for this primer × minboot
  if (length(blank_index_list[[i]]) > 0) {
    blank_mat <- dat_filt[[i]][, blank_index_list[[i]], drop = FALSE]
    n_blanks  <- rowSums(blank_mat > 0)
    bl_sv     <- row.names(dat_filt[[i]])[n_blanks >= blank_n_remove]
  } else {
    bl_sv <- character(0)
  }

  # OR logic: remove if flagged by either method
  remove_sv   <- union(dc_sv, bl_sv)
  keep        <- !row.names(dat_filt[[i]]) %in% remove_sv
  dat_filt[[i]] <- dat_filt[[i]][keep, ]

  # update summary stats (used by summary_table chunk)
  after_blank_filt[[i]]       <- length(row.names(dat_filt[[i]]))
  after_blank_filt1[[i]]      <- apply(dat_filt[[i]][, all_index_list[[i]]], 2, sum)
  after_blank_filt_SVsam[[i]] <- apply(dat_filt[[i]][, all_index_list[[i]]], 2,
                                       function(x) sum(x > 0))
}

cat("\nContamination filter applied: decontam OR ≥", blank_n_remove, "blanks\n")
cat("SVs remaining per primer (minboot =", minboots_summary, "):\n")
for (nm in primers_minboot[decontam_idx]) {
  cat(" ", nm, ":", after_blank_filt[[nm]], "SVs\n")
}
```

```{r decontam_plot1}

  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed") +

  ggplot2::theme(strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))
```

## decontam plot 2: one panel per top-flagged SV, proportion vs DNA concentration
Contaminants should show higher proportion at LOW concentration.
Blue circles = true samples; red triangles = blanks (plotted at x = -4).
Facets = individual SVs (Genus Species + decontam p-value); primers with no
flagged SVs are skipped with a message.  Single ggplot object → always renders.
```{r decontam_plot2}
p2_data <- purrr::map_dfr(decontam_plot_data, function(d) {
  if (length(d$top_svs) == 0) {
    message(d$nm, " \u2014 no contaminants flagged, skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }
  # drop samples with zero total reads (avoids 0/0 in proportion)
  keep     <- rowSums(d$sv_mat) > 0
  sv_sub   <- d$sv_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  conc_sub <- d$conc[keep]
  neg_sub  <- d$neg[keep]
  log_conc <- ifelse(neg_sub, log10(1e-4), log10(conc_sub + 1e-4))
  total    <- rowSums(sv_sub)

  # one row per sample per top SV — each SV becomes its own facet panel
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(d$top_svs), function(k) {
    sv_reads <- sv_sub[, d$top_svs[k]]
    data.frame(
      taxon    = d$taxon_labels[k],
      log_conc = log_conc,
      prop     = ifelse(total > 0, sv_reads / total, NA_real_),
      type     = ifelse(neg_sub, "blank", "sample")
    )
  })
})

ggplot2::ggplot(p2_data, ggplot2::aes(x = log_conc, y = prop,
                                       colour = type, shape = type)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(sample = "steelblue", blank = "red")) +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values  = c(sample = 16,          blank = 17)) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ taxon, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title  = "Top 5 decontam-flagged SVs: proportion vs extracted DNA concentration",
    x      = "log10(extracted DNA conc, ng/\u00b5l)",
    y      = "proportion of reads",
    colour = NULL, shape = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top",
                 strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 7))
```

```{r summary_table}
after_min_sample_filt_SVsam <- mes

nnn <- "after_blank_filt"
mes <- after_blank_filt1
mes <- purrr::map(mes, vec_to_df)
mes <- bind_rows(mes, .id = "primer_taxassign_id")
names(mes)[3] <- nnn
after_blank_filt1 <- mes

nnn <- "SV_after_blank_filt"
mes <- after_blank_filt_SVsam
mes <- purrr::map(mes, vec_to_df)
mes <- bind_rows(mes, .id = "primer_taxassign_id")
names(mes)[3] <- nnn
after_blank_filt_SVsam <- mes

nnn <- "after_taxa_clean"
mes <- after_taxa_clean1
mes <- purrr::map(mes, vec_to_df)
mes <- bind_rows(mes, .id = "primer_taxassign_id")
names(mes)[3] <- nnn
after_taxa_clean1 <- mes

nnn <- "SV_after_taxa_clean"
mes <- after_taxa_clean1_SVsam
mes <- purrr::map(mes, vec_to_df)
mes <- bind_rows(mes, .id = "primer_taxassign_id")
names(mes)[3] <- nnn
after_taxa_clean1_SVsam <- mes

## after_taxa_sum_SV_sam elements are grouped tibbles (primer_taxassign_id, miseq_sample_id, SV)
## use imap_dfr to select columns by name and strip grouping before binding
after_taxa_sum_SV_sam <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  after_taxa_sum_SV_sam,
  function(df, nm) {
    df <- as.data.frame(df)              # strip grouping attribute
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)      # skip empty elements (e.g. insect assignments)
    data.frame(
      primer_taxassign_id = nm,
      sample_num          = as.integer(df$miseq_sample_id),
      SV_after_taxa_sum   = df$SV
    )
  }
)


## combine all tables
filter_summary_per_sample<-after_n_occurance_per_sample1 %>%    # names(filter_summary_per_sample)
  left_join(after_min_sample_filt1) %>%
  left_join(after_blank_filt1) %>% 
  left_join(after_taxa_clean1) %>% 
  #
  left_join(after_min_sample_filt_SVsam) %>% 
  left_join(after_blank_filt_SVsam) %>% 
  left_join(after_taxa_clean1_SVsam) %>%
  #
  mutate(sample_num= as.numeric( gsub('X_', '', as.character(sample_num))) ) %>%  # remove "X_" from sample_num
  #
  left_join(after_taxa_sum_SV_sam) %>%
  #
  separate(primer_taxassign_id, into=c("primer_pair", "taxa_assign")  , sep=";", remove=FALSE) %>%   # split primer_taxassign_id to match with dada2_summary     names(filter_summary_per_sample)
  mutate(sample_num=as.character(sample_num)) %>% # need for next join
  left_join(dada_summary2) %>% 
  mutate(sample_num=as.numeric(sample_num))  %>% # change back for consistancy
  select(primer_taxassign_id,primer_pair,taxa_assign,sample_num, primer_removed, filtered, 
         denoised, FandR_merged, bimeras_removed, 
         after_n_occurance_per_sample, after_min_sample_filt, after_blank_filt , after_taxa_clean,
         SV_after_min_sample_filt, SV_after_blank_filt, SV_after_taxa_clean, SV_after_taxa_sum)   # reorder columns


###########################
## clculate unique SV's after filters per miseq/taxaassign
## these have 1 number per miseq Removed Feb. 24, 2020!!!, if need go to Dammam scripts ?????

## TO DO ----- remove the following from above..
mes<-after_n_occurance_per_sample    # mes2<-mes[[1]] names(mes)
mes<-after_blank_filt
mes<-after_min_sample_filt
mes<-after_taxa_clean
mes<-after_taxa_sum


###########################################
#### combine all filtering into per primer/taxa assign     ####    unique(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot$sample_id_simple)
filter_summary_per_primer_minboot <- filter_summary_per_sample %>%  #   names(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot)
    left_join(sample_sam[,1:5], by = c("primer_pair" = "id", "sample_num" = "sample_num") ) %>%   # join with smaple_sam to get consistant sample names
    filter( !(type=="mock" | type =="positive control")) %>%  ## remove moc  unique(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot$type)
    mutate(type2=if_else(type =="extraction blank" | type=="pcr blank", "blanks", "samples", type)) %>% #unique(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot$type)
    group_by(primer_taxassign_id, primer_pair, taxa_assign, type2)  %>% 
    #summarize_at(vars(primer_removed:after_taxa_clean), sum) %>% 
    summarise(across(primer_removed:SV_after_taxa_sum,
                     list(mean=~mean(., na.rm=TRUE), se=~plotrix::std.error(.)))) %>%
  ## add data on unique SV per miseq  ??  - no  !! removed
    #left_join(after_n_occurance_per_sample) %>% 
    #left_join(after_min_sample_filt)  %>% 
    #left_join(after_blank_filt) %>%  
    #left_join(after_taxa_clean) %>% 
    #left_join(after_taxa_sum)     %>% 
    #left_join(primer_names)     %>%  # add good primer names
    #select(-primer_pair) %>%   # names(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot)
    dplyr::rename(eDNA = type2, primers = primer_pair) %>% 
    filter(taxa_assign %in% minboots_summary) %>%  ###    !!!!!   remove insect !!!!!!
    # filter(primers %in% primers_summary) %>%  ###    !!!!!   keep used primers !!!!!!
    #mutate(primers=factor(primers, levels= primers_summary)) %>% 
    arrange(primers, desc(taxa_assign), desc(eDNA) )
  

#################### makes summary tables to then be exported
# names(filter_summary_per_primer_minboot)

DADA<-filter_summary_per_primer_minboot %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    distinct(primers,eDNA, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
    select(primers,eDNA,primer_removed_mean, primer_removed_se,filtered_mean,filtered_se,denoised_mean,denoised_se,
           FandR_merged_mean,FandR_merged_se,bimeras_removed_mean,bimeras_removed_se) %>% 
   arrange(primers, desc(eDNA) )
  

# if filtered by minimum number of samples then --   after_min_sample_filt_mean  and    unique_SV_after_min_sample_filt
post_DADA_sum<-filter_summary_per_primer_minboot %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(primers,taxa_assign, eDNA, after_n_occurance_per_sample_mean, after_n_occurance_per_sample_se,
           after_blank_filt_mean, after_blank_filt_se, after_taxa_clean_mean, after_taxa_clean_se,
           SV_after_min_sample_filt_mean,SV_after_min_sample_filt_se, 
           SV_after_blank_filt_mean,  SV_after_blank_filt_se,
           SV_after_taxa_clean_mean, SV_after_taxa_clean_se,
           SV_after_taxa_sum_mean, SV_after_taxa_sum_se ) %>%  
   arrange(primers, desc(taxa_assign), desc(eDNA))
```
